changelog:
- Initial release of new-product-insight-analyzer skill.
- Provides concise competitive assessment reports on newly launched products based on official releases and authoritative tech sources.
- Supports core tech specs extraction, generational/industry comparisons, and competitive moat evaluation.
- Output includes: major specs & highlights, innovation level, target markets, key pain points solved, and barrier assessment.
- Designed for investment, procurement, and competitive analysis contexts; requires only company name, with smart product/latest release detection.
